Bug_Title: Locks should be released on all paths
Bug_Explanation: The lock is acquired but only released if a specific condition (initialization) is met. If the condition is not met, the lock is never released, causing a potential deadlock.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case initializes the BuggyClass object and then calls the showBug() method which in turn calls the doSomething() method. If the doSomething() method fails to release the lock when the 'initialized' field is true, then the assertTrue(buggyClass.lock.tryLock()) line will fail because the lock will not be free to be acquired.
